note: The registry of hand-written validators admitted with a differential equivalence proof. Exactly one entry at this revision. A pattern is looked up here only after patterns.mjs has decided it is not expressible in the declared subset; a pattern in neither place stops generation with UNSUPPORTED_PATTERN.

^(?!/)(?![A-Za-z]:)(?!.*\\\\)(?!.*(?:^|/.reason: The pattern carries four lookaheads. No RE2-family engine compiles a lookahead, and this backend generates its own matcher rather than linking one, so the declared subset of patterns.mjs cannot express it and a hand-written validator with a proof is the only alternative to refusing the one path member every IR document carries.
^(?!/)(?![A-Za-z]:)(?!.*\\\\)(?!.*(?:^|/.equivalenceArgument: Anchored at both ends, the pattern is a conjunction of five independent clauses over the subject read as UTF-16 code units: the trailing [^\u0000]+ makes the subject non-empty and NUL-free; (?!/) forbids a leading solidus; (?![A-Za-z]:) forbids a leading ASCII drive letter; (?!.*\\) forbids a backslash in the head, the prefix before the first line terminator, because . excludes all four ECMAScript line terminators with no s flag; and (?!.*(?:^|/)\.\.(?:/|$)) forbids a parent-directory segment whose two dots lie in the head, whose preceding position is the string start or a solidus, and which is followed by a solidus or the end of the subject, where ^ and $ bind to the whole subject because there is no m flag. SourceLocusPath::try_new decides exactly that conjunction, clause for clause, in the same code-unit basis.
^(?!/)(?![A-Za-z]:)(?!.*\\\\)(?!.*(?:^|/.probeAlphabetNote: Every class the pattern discriminates has a member: an ordinary character, the solidus the segment rule turns on, the backslash the head rule turns on, the dot the parent-directory rule turns on, the colon the drive-letter rule turns on, all four ECMAScript line terminators because the head is defined by them and an alphabet with only U+000A admits a validator that treats U+000A as the only terminator and still agrees on every probed string, and U+0000 which the character class excludes.

divergence.note: The published language admits a value carrying a line terminator followed by a parent-directory segment, because the head guards stop at the first line terminator. SourceLocusPath::is_traversal_free decides the intended language instead and is required, in addition, wherever a value governed by this pattern addresses the filesystem.
